record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: project-ops
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: Project.apply and cmd_apply accept the same NDJSON mutation ops the command already supported (create, update, supersede, correct, contradict) and persist each operation in the sequence with continue-and-report semantics (project-ops approach; design interfaces for Project.apply).
    observed: At phase head, Project._apply_operation only handles create and update; supersede, correct, and contradict raise unsupported op. cmd_apply delegates entirely to Project.apply and its help text was narrowed to create/update only. Base cli.py cmd_apply routed through _APPLY_OPS including supersede, correct, and contradict.
    severity: major
  - task: command-facade
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: cmd_apply calls Project.apply while preserving prior batch NDJSON behavior for mutation ops the command read from NDJSON (command-facade approach).
    observed: cmd_apply now forwards all parsed lines to Project.apply, so NDJSON lines with op supersede, correct, or contradict fail where they previously invoked _do_supersede / _do_correct / _do_contradict.
    severity: major
integration:
  interfaces: adaptive_artifacts.project adds open_store, StoreBindingError, Binding, and Project with get/list/create/apply; adaptive_artifacts.record holds base_record/now shared with cli. cli _apply_paths resolves root and, without --store, calls open_store and sets args.project/args.store/contract; create/get/apply use _command_project and Project ops; list and other mutators still use _open_store on args.store from _apply_paths. Tests test_open_store.py (R1–R13), test_project_ops.py (R15–R19), test_command_facade.py (R14, R20, R21).
  assumptions: Graded only from /tmp/aa-library-review-scope.md and read-only inspection of tree at 206fcd0b; ignored execution reports, check-runs, assessments, and assignments as instructed. Did not run pytest. Existing tools/runtime tests were not part of the phase diff but inform prior apply behavior.
  invariants: open_store resolution order and no-fallthrough on missing meta match project.py and test_open_store.py; package source contains no SE_WORKFLOW_STORE reads (R14); cli path selection no longer uses default_store_path/git-common-dir fallback, aligned with open_store for create/get via _apply_paths; explicit path/env/binding errors do not open alternate stores in tests. cmd apply NDJSON surface no longer matches pre-phase command apply (see findings).
  conflicts: none
record.subject: aa-library-review
